model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 RedCraft 3.0 (FixQW21T) 7B + Texture-fix VAE
model.description: RedCraft 3.0 (FixQW21T) 7B with the vendor texture-fix VAE (qwen_image_21_vae_texturefix_bf16.safetensors, CivitAI version 3407259) instead of the official Qwen Image 2.1 VAE, aiming at cleaner 2K texture detail. Same INT8 Comfy ConvRot checkpoint as the base entry. Requires the texture-fix VAE in ckpts/qwen_image_21/ (the base entry of this model downloads everything needed and the standalone VAE file can be fetched from the vendor card); WanGP converts the vendor's native Wan-style tensor naming on the fly. Pick the base 'Qwen Image 2.1 RedCraft 3.0 (FixQW21T) 7B' entry to use the official VAE.
model.author: RedCraft

prompt: A cream travel poster with a flat blue mountain illustration, a large navy title reading "EXPLORE" and a smaller subtitle reading "Find your next trail". Balanced typography, clean generous margins, fine paper texture.
